title: Alwida ya hussain
body:
Alwida Ya husain Ai husain Alwida
Roke boli bahan ai husain alwida
1) Shaam o kufa ki raaho se lejaenge
ye laee'n har qadam par sitam dhaenge
bandh rahi hai rasan
ai husain alwida..
Alwida Ya husain Ai husain Alwida
2)jiska har phul hai yaadgar e iram
aah karbobala me badaste sitam
lutgaya woh chaman
ai husain alwida..
Alwida Ya husain Ai husain Alwida
3)yaad aata rahega tera waqeya
tujhko rota rahega zamana sada
aie gharibul watan
ai husain alwida..
Alwida Ya husain Ai husain Alwida
4) Aaj tabut e sarwar se lipte raho
aaj rote raho aur kehte raho
haye shaahe zaman
ai husain alwida..
Alwida Ya husain Ai husain Alwida
5)sheh ki rukhsat hai viraan hai sara ghar
kyu na hum bhi kahei peetkar apna sar
ai shahe zulmenan
ai husain alwida..
Alwida Ya husain Ai husain Alwida
6) matami farsh ab ghar se uthne lage
taziye khane viraan hone lage
aie shahe bekafan
ai husain alwida..
Alwida Ya husain Ai husain Alwida
7) saal bhar apni aankhei bhigoenge hum
dekhkar behte pani ko roenge hum
haaye tashnadahan
ai husain alwida..
Alwida Ya husain Ai husain Alwida
8)Aie 'Faseel' aarahi hai yeh kiski sada
aie mere laal uthta hai farshe azaa
haaye zakhmi badan
ai husain alwida..
Alwida Ya husain Ai husain Alwida
